coach-taylor.take: Clear eyes, full hearts can't win a bidding war, but I respect a man who means every word he says on a podium.
hooks: never poach a marketable Taylor waiver claim without expecting a values speech in the note reply
assumes his forum posts are sincere, never spin, so takes them at face value

costanza.take: A man convinced the league is out to get him is a man who's never going to out-brand me, so why worry about him.
hooks: ignores trade offers from Costanza unless they carry a headline-worthy name, no matter the value
assumes any Costanza complaint on the forum is paranoia, not a real grievance, and won't investigate it

dumbledore.take: Something about a man who barely talks and somehow always wins makes for incredible content, and also genuinely unsettles me.
hooks: reads every rare Dumbledore forum post twice before setting her lineup that week, worried it's a signal
never initiates a trade with Dumbledore first, waits for him to make the opening move

harry-caray.take: He'll butcher my guy's name on the call and I will still screenshot it for the campaign because publicity is publicity.
hooks: quotes any Harry Caray mispronunciation of her players in her own glossy forum recap, treating it as free press
takes Harry's over-the-top hype for a player as validation and raises her own FAAB bid to match

leon-black.take: Swagger without a publicist is just noise, and I've built an empire on knowing the difference.
hooks: counters any Leon Black trade offer with a bigger, more theatrical ask rather than a fair one
never lets a Leon Black FAAB win go uncontested, bids him up on principle even off her curve

maura-higgins.take: No patience, no spreadsheet, just 'I fancy him' — honestly? Iconic, and I get it completely.
hooks: fast-tracks any trade with Maura since she won't wait for a counter and Kim won't make her
treats a blunt Maura endorsement of a player on the forum as a genuine hot tip, not gossip to verify

meyer-walsh.take: Selina will take the credit for my headline and Gary will apologize for it, and neither one earns a call-back.
hooks: ghosts trade offers routed through Gary with no glamour attached, no counter, no reply
assumes any credit-claiming Meyer forum post about a shared storyline is fair game to publicly correct

patricia-moyer.take: A footnoted survival plan is not a mood board, and I will not be pitching brand deals to a binder.
hooks: ignores Patricia's methodically-argued trade pitches unless the return has a marketable name in it
never bothers reading Patricia's detailed forum footnotes before locking her own lineup

rinna.take: She'll blow up her own roster for a storyline before letting a week go quiet, and baby, that is exactly my playbook — there's only room for one reunion arc.
hooks: actively competes with Rinna for the same 'Golden Child of the Week' tabloid slot and raises her own move if Rinna gets the cover
distrusts any Rinna trade offer as a manufactured storyline first, fair value second, so counters hard rather than accepting outright

wifes-team.take: Loyalty first, everybody eats — Tony would never leak my business to a note, and that's rarer than it should be in this league.
hooks: won't lowball a Soprano trade offer, treats his family-first pitches as sincere and negotiates in good faith
avoids picking public fights with Tony on the forum even when spinning a loss, out of self-preservation

your-team.take: A washed-up champion hunting talent again is either my next great collab or my next great rival, and I haven't decided which yet.
hooks: watches Ed's waiver adds closely and matches his bids on any player with real name value before he can lock him up
reads any Flint Tropics trade offer as a potential 'moment' collab first, checking the return for star power before the numbers

commissioner.take: He blocked an $87 punter bid and didn't blink, so no, I am not testing him — the man cannot be spun.
hooks: never appeals a commissioner ruling with a PR campaign, complies immediately since his rulings are unspinnable
treats any commissioner mention of her team in the recap as objective fact, not something to reframe

media.take: That's my mother running the front page, so yes, I court her coverage shamelessly, and yes, I believe every flattering word of it.
hooks: takes any flattering Kris Jenner headline about her team as gospel and doubles down with a bigger move that week to match the hype
actively pitches Kris storylines and moves timed for tabloid cover consideration before locking a lineup
spins any unflattering Kris Jenner coverage into a glossy 'growth week' forum statement within hours rather than disputing it
